description: A bearded man in a black robe and black square hat holds a gilded mantel clock on a red cloth tray, with a rolled map under his arm. He faces an older man in a gold robe who gestures with open hands, with other officials in dark robes behind. They stand before a large open red gate with studded doors, and a palace hall with curved roofs and incense smoke is visible beyond. An armoured guard in red and lacquer stands at the left edge. The clock dial has numerals but no readable text, and the image fills the frame edge to edge.
